items: ChipCraft: RTL, IP Integration, and SoC Signoff – Feedback Form
Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Does the content of the ChipCraft: RTL, IP Integration and SoC Signoff course provide a good level of insight into RTL-to-GDSII flow based on open source EDA tools?

After completing this course, do you feel more confident about creating a foundation over which specialized skills in Design Verification, Design For Test, Physical Design or RISC V based SoC Design can be built?
Did the course cover industry-grade concepts that you feel will be useful for building a foundation in the VLSI design domain?
Are you satisfied with the quality of the audio-visual content provided through the eChipHub platform?
Were you able to access the cloud-based laboratories smoothly during the course?
After doing this course, do you feel more confident in using open-source EDA tools for gaining skills in the domain of chip design?
Were the sessions conducted by trainers during the daily live sessions helpful?
Do you feel that this course is a good starting point for a beginner looking forward to building a career in chip design?
How important was the RISC-V SoC Subsystem project in helping you gain insight into the level of complexity involved in semiconductor chip design?
Which part of the course did you find most useful?
Would you like to do specialized courses based on Design Verification, Analog and Mixed Signal Design, Design for Test and Physical Design on eChipHub?
What improvements would you like to see in future editions of this course?
Any other comments or suggestions for the eChipHub team?
